g.text: What this shows: The standard null (left) shuffles the target across all 38 subjects, producing a distribution centered at -0.393. The observed +0.376 clears p=0.007. But this null is blind to arm membership and noise structure. The arm-stratified null (right, HYPOTHETICAL) shuffles the target within each arm, preserving arm structure but breaking the individual target-feature link. If the observed Spearman drops below the stratified null p95, the model was detecting arm membership (Reading B).

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: What it does not show: The actual arm-stratified null distribution — it has not been computed yet. The right panel is illustrative only.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555
